blockedTests.name: P-521 mismatched curves
blockedTests.reason: Web Cryptography Level 2 ED (2026-10-22) §24.4.2 steps 4-8 checks the public peer's output bound before curve equality. This case requests more than its P-256 peer's 256 bits, so the required OperationError precedes the pinned WPT's expected InvalidAccessError. Existing crypto-ec.test.ts paired controls exercise both orders.
